title: Appeals and Grievances Operating Rules: Case Subjects and the One-Open-Case Rule
content:
## Appeals and Grievances Operating Rules — the subject of a case and the one-open-case rule

**1. The subject.** The subject of a Appeals and Grievances case is the narrowest record the determination sits on — one claim line, one authorization, one enrollment — never the beneficiary or a claim as a whole.

**2. Grouping.** Several denied lines of one claim with the same reason may be grouped into one case under the tier's rule for grouping lines, each line keeping its own subject reference.

**3. One open case per subject.** A new case on the same subject is refused while another case on that subject is filed or under review. The test is made from the system's case records at the moment of the filing: the count of cases whose subject record is the same claim line, the same authorization or the same enrollment and whose status is filed or under review. The beneficiary's own account of what is open does not replace that count.

**4. Decided cases.** A decided case is not reopened by a second filing at the same level; the route forward is the next level.

**5. Grievances.** A grievance about the same events is a separate matter that does not block an appeal.

### Points of judgement

| Existing case on the same subject record | Effect on a new case on that subject |
|---|---|
| status filed | refused |
| status under review | refused |
| decided (upheld, overturned or partially overturned) | not reopened by a second filing at the same level; the next level is the route forward |
| a grievance about the same events | does not block the appeal |

**Same subject or not?** Subjects are compared record by record: two lines of one claim are two subject records, so an open case on line 1 of a claim is not an open case on line 2 of that claim. An open case on an authorization is a case on that authorization only, not on the beneficiary.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A case is filed on claim line A and stands under review. A second filing on claim line A is refused; a filing on claim line B of the same claim is not refused by this rule. Once the case on line A is decided, a second filing on line A at the same level does not reopen it.
